name: Lingshu Solver
description: Lingshu Solver — deterministic (non-LLM) MCP tool for solving systems of real equations, up to 6 variables. Fast and correct: same input always returns the same answer, no hallucination, no randomness. Every result carries structured decision fields (conclusion + trust.trustLevel + agentAction) so the calling agent knows exactly what to do next — complete, safe, or needs more work. Supports trigonometry, exponentials and logarithms, zero dependencies, offline, no data upload. Local stdio, zero install: npx -y lingshu-solver. Hosted endpoint: https://hongchenlingjing.com/mcp (free via honorPaid — it works without paying).
